The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what I did.

## Summary

The task was to relocate `ResettableSystemProperties` — a utility for setting system properties and resetting them on `close()` — out of the core runtime module so it can't reach the classpath of production applications.

### Investigation
- The class lived at `core/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/runtime/ResettableSystemProperties.java` (part of the `quarkus-core` **runtime** artifact, which ships to production apps).
- The provided verification test `ResettableSystemPropertiesAbsenceTest` asserts `Class.forName("io.quarkus.runtime.ResettableSystemProperties")` throws `ClassNotFoundException` on the core runtime classpath.
- The only production consumer was the **liquibase** extension runtime (`LiquibaseFactory` + `LiquibaseRecorder`), which used it at app startup to set `liquibase.allowDuplicatedChangesetIdentifiers`. (Upstream Quarkus actually spread its usage further — this is the reverse of that direction — so I designed the relocation directly.)

### Changes (source files only)
1. **Relocated the class** from `core/runtime` to `core/deployment` (`core/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/runtime/ResettableSystemProperties.java`), keeping its `io.quarkus.runtime` package. `quarkus-core-deployment` is a build/dev-time module that is never on a production app's runtime classpath, satisfying "accessible only in testing/development environments." The class content is unchanged.

2. **Refactored the liquibase runtime** (production code) so it no longer references the relocated class:
   - `LiquibaseFactory.createResettableSystemProperties()` now returns a plain `AutoCloseable` and inlines the set-then-restore logic directly.
   - `LiquibaseRecorder` uses `AutoCloseable` in its try-with-resources and drops the import.

### Result
- `io.quarkus.runtime.ResettableSystemProperties` is no longer in the core runtime module (`ClassNotFoundException` on that classpath — the absence test passes).
- The class now lives only in the non-runtime `core/deployment` module.
- The liquibase feature (resettable system property during migration) behaves identically without any shared utility on the production classpath.

I left all `src/test` files untouched, as the verification system applies test patches automatically. No changes to a `tests/` directory were made (none exists in this repo).
